items.description: HeroUI-inspired button with solid, bordered, flat, light, faded, shadow, and ghost variants.

import { cva } from "class-variance-authority"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

export const base = [
  "relative inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap",
  "text-sm font-medium",
  "transition-[transform,opacity,box-shadow,background-color,border-color,color]",
  "duration-150 ease-out",
  "select-none cursor-pointer",
  "active:scale-[0.97]",
  "disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50",
  "[&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4 [&_svg]:shrink-0",
].join(" ")

export const buttonVariants = cva(base, {
  variants: {
    variant: {
      solid: "",
      bordered: "",
      flat: "",
      light: "",
      faded: "",
      shadow: "",
      ghost: "",

    color: {
      default: "",
      primary: "",
      secondary: "",
      success: "",
      warning: "",
      danger: "",

      md: "h-10 px-4 text-sm",

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: HeroUI-inspired Switch with spring animated thumb motion.

files.content:
import * as React from "react"
import * as SwitchPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-switch"
import { type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"
import { switchVariants } from "./switch.variants"

export type SwitchVariantProps = VariantProps<typeof switchVariants>;

export type SwitchBaseProps = Omit<
  React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef<typeof SwitchPrimitive.Root>,
  keyof SwitchVariantProps
>;

export interface SwitchProps
  extends SwitchBaseProps,
    SwitchVariantProps {
  label?: React.ReactNode
  description?: React.ReactNode
}
